calls.title: Tanner Green and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: Team members discussed issues related to demo scheduling, emphasizing the need to eliminate low-conversion prep sessions that waste resources. Ashley highlighted the inefficiencies caused by ineffective prep sessions, particularly for big companies like Walmart and Airbnb, prompting a shift towards direct qualification before scheduling calls. The group also agreed to centralize episode assets in a Google Sheets CMS, streamlining content management and workflow as the guest approval process was noted to cause significant delays. Coordinated timing for publishing across platforms was emphasized to avoid conflicts and maintain audience engagement, particularly with newsletters. Lastly, the team recognized the need for clearer workflow documentation to ensure accountability and efficiency in their processes.
calls.keywords: podcast publishing, content workflow, episode approval, CMS management, social media scheduling, newsletter timing
